targets.rawSql: SELECT quantile(0.95)(duration_ms) AS value FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE event_type='llm.completed' AND status='ok' AND event_time_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND engine IN (${engine:sqlstring}) AND device IN (${device:sqlstring}) AND match(pipeline_version, '^(${pipeline_version:regex})$')

SELECT quantile(0.95)(ttft_ms) AS value FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE event_type='llm.completed' AND status='ok' AND event_time_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND engine IN (${engine:sqlstring}) AND device IN (${device:sqlstring}) AND match(pipeline_version, '^(${pipeline_version:regex})$')

SELECT quantile(0.95)(realtime_factor) AS value FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE event_type='stt.segment_profile' AND event_time_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND engine IN (${engine:sqlstring}) AND device IN (${device:sqlstring}) AND match(pipeline_version, '^(${pipeline_version:regex})$')

SELECT toStartOfFiveMinutes(toDateTime(intDiv(event_time_ms,1000))) AS time, pipeline_version AS metric, quantile(0.95)(duration_ms) AS value FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE event_type='llm.completed' AND status='ok' AND event_time_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND engine IN (${engine:sqlstring}) AND device IN (${device:sqlstring}) AND match(pipeline_version, '^(${pipeline_version:regex})$') GROUP BY time, pipeline_version ORDER BY time, metric

SELECT pipeline_version, countIf(event_type='llm.completed') AS llm_calls, round(quantileIf(0.95)(duration_ms,event_type='llm.completed' AND status='ok'),0) AS llm_e2e_p95_ms, round(quantileIf(0.95)(ttft_ms,event_type='llm.completed' AND status='ok'),0) AS ttft_p95_ms, round(avgIf(decode_tokens_per_second,event_type='llm.completed' AND status='ok'),1) AS avg_decode_tok_s, countIf(event_type='stt.segment_profile') AS stt_segments, round(quantileIf(0.95)(realtime_factor,event_type='stt.segment_profile'),3) AS stt_rtf_p95, countIf(event_type='tts.completed') AS tts_calls, round(quantileIf(0.95)(duration_ms,event_type='tts.completed' AND status='ok'),0) AS tts_e2e_p95_ms, round(quantileIf(0.95)(compute_ms,event_type='tts.completed' AND status='ok'),0) AS tts_compute_p95_ms, round(quantileIf(0.95)(time_to_first_audio_ms,event_type='tts.first_audio_queued' AND status='ok' AND time_to_first_audio_ms > 0),0) AS endpoint_to_first_pcm_p95_ms FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE event_time_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND engine IN (${engine:sqlstring}) AND device IN (${device:sqlstring}) AND match(pipeline_version, '^(${pipeline_version:regex})$') GROUP BY pipeline_version ORDER BY llm_calls DESC

SELECT session_id, pipeline_version, toDateTime(intDiv(closed_at_ms,1000)) AS closed_at, outcome, closed_at_ms-started_at_ms AS duration_ms, JSONExtractUInt(totals_json,'turns') AS turns, JSONExtractUInt(totals_json,'llm_calls') AS llm_calls FROM pipeline.session_summaries WHERE closed_at_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND session_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT session_id FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND engine IN (${engine:sqlstring}) AND device IN (${device:sqlstring})) AND match(pipeline_version, '^(${pipeline_version:regex})$') ORDER BY duration_ms DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT toStartOfFiveMinutes(toDateTime(intDiv(event_time_ms,1000))) AS time, pipeline_version AS metric, quantile(0.95)(time_to_first_audio_ms) AS value FROM pipeline.pipeline_events WHERE event_type='tts.first_audio_queued' AND status='ok' AND time_to_first_audio_ms > 0 AND event_time_ms BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND model IN (${model:sqlstring}) AND engine IN (${engine:sqlstring}) AND device IN (${device:sqlstring}) AND match(pipeline_version, '^(${pipeline_version:regex})$') GROUP BY time, pipeline_version ORDER BY time, metric
